# typeassert: insert assertion after if when body always returns (switch path)
typeassert {
	var i I
	i.Kind() == 1 -> i.(T1)
}
-- x.go --
package m

type I interface {
	Kind() int
	Do()
}

type T1 struct{}
func (T1) Kind() int { return 1 }
func (T1) Do()       {}

func F(x I) {
	if x.Kind() != 1 {
		switch {
		default:
			return
		}
	}
	x.Do()
}
